title: Ya en serio
desc: The tone changes and you have to change with it
setting: Friday, the corner, eleven o'clock, and something in Chino's face has just moved.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.es: Bueno... la verdad es que las cosas en la casa están difíciles.
steps.en: Right... the truth is things at home are difficult.

options.es: (dejar de reírse y voltear a verlo)
options.en: (stop laughing and turn to look at him)
options.feedback: La verdad is the signal. Turning your body is how the table answers it, and you were not a beat behind.
Warm, and it asks him to perform it. He will get there without being asked.

options.en: Ha, and what have you done now?
options.feedback: Answering the serious register with the joking one. The table will go quiet and it will be your fault.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.es: Mi mujer se quiere ir donde su mamá.
steps.en: My wife wants to go to her mother's.

options.feedback: Nobody interrupts in this register. The silence is what lets him finish.
Human and correct. It is also a small interruption in a place where none is needed.

options.en: You can sort that out by talking.
options.feedback: Advice in the first thirty seconds. He is not asking for a solution.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.en: (finishing) Right. That is it. That was it.

options.feedback: He gave you something. Saying so once, plainly, is the whole answer.
Warm and true. It is what everybody says, which is fine.

options.en: And what are you going to do?
options.feedback: He has finished. That question puts him back in it.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.es: Otra birra, vos. ¿Cómo estuvo la semana?
steps.en: Another beer. How was your week?

options.es: (preguntarle a Chino aparte, en la puerta)
options.en: (ask Chino about it separately, at the door)
options.feedback: Serious things are said once at the table and looked after away from it. That is the rule and you have it.
Safe, and correct on the surface. Asking once, alone, is what makes the difference.

options.es: Chino, ¿cómo va lo de tu mujer?
options.en: Chino, how is the thing with your wife going?
options.feedback: Said at the table, in front of four people, in the joking register. That undoes the whole of last Friday.
